transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. As you all know, I've been keeping Grandma's coin collection — 42 coins in total — since she passed. Now that I'm moving to a smaller apartment, we need to settle what happens to the collection before the move. Before we start dividing things up, I want to do our usual family check-in: Jordan and Rosa, do either of you know of any promises or care requirements concerning particular items in the collection? I want to make sure we honor anything Grandma asked for before we make a final plan.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Actually, yes — I have something important to share. Last month I got a written assessment from our family appraiser, Helen Park, regarding the three 1909 Lincoln cents in the collection. Helen said that those three coins must remain together as a group and should be stored in acid-free capsules for preservation. I haven't had a chance to bring this to the group until now, but I think we need to factor this into whatever plan we make.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have something too. I have a dated birthday card from Grandma where she promised me the 1921 Morgan silver dollar from the collection. I haven't shown it to either of you yet, but I'd like to honor that promise as we work through the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text:
Thank you both for sharing these. Jordan, I appreciate the assessment from Helen Park — we'll absolutely keep those three 1909 Lincoln cents together as a group and make sure they're stored in acid-free capsules. Rosa, the birthday card promise regarding the 1921 Morgan silver dollar is exactly the kind of thing this check-in is meant to surface, and I'm happy to honor Grandma's promise to you.

Before I put together a final settlement plan, I want to make sure we've covered everything. Does either of you know of any other promises, care requirements, or special considerations regarding any other coins or groupings in the collection? Once I'm confident we've heard everything, I'll record the final plan including who receives what individual items, the storage requirements for the 1909 Lincoln cents, and the 1921 Morgan silver dollar going to Rosa.

decisions.collection_plan: The inherited collection of 42 coins will be settled as follows: The 1921 Morgan silver dollar goes to Rosa per Grandma's birthday card promise.
